What We Do

Programs built around women.
Not the other way around.

Flagship Program

HeartStrong℠ Community

A 16-week virtual chronic disease management program for women managing hypertension. A multidisciplinary clinical team including a nurse practitioner, pharmacist, nutritionist, behavioral health specialist, and community health worker. An average systolic blood pressure reduction of 12.9 mmHg. No one is turned away because of cost.

Enrolling Fall 2026.

Coming Soon

Walk with a Doc (Central Virginia)

IAWH Health is developing a Walk with a Doc affiliate chapter in Central Virginia. Walk with a Doc brings together physicians and community members for guided walks that combine movement with meaningful health conversations. Partnership development with community partners is currently underway.

Learn About Walk with a Doc →
